app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

insights: The cart deployment has an active pod (cart-5df68c7b56-wzdnr) in Running state — the pod itself is not crashing or in CrashLoopBackOff.
Pod logs contain many normal cart operations (GetCart/AddItem/EmptyCart) followed by repeated failures: 'Wasn't able to connect to redis'.

Logs include a gRPC error: FailedPrecondition with detail 'Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis' and a stack trace pointing to cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected().

Root cause confirmed: the cart service cannot connect to its Redis/Valkey-backed cart storage; this dependency connectivity failure causes the gRPC FailedPrecondition errors when cart storage is accessed.

This is an application-level dependency availability/connectivity issue (cart -> Valkey/Redis), not a pod runtime crash — remediation should focus on restoring Redis/Valkey accessibility (service health, networking, credentials, or DNS) rather than restarting the cart pod.

final_report.root_cause: The cart service pod (cart-5df68c7b56-wzdnr) was unable to establish connections to its Redis/Valkey-backed cart storage (EnsureRedisConnected failed). This dependency-connectivity failure caused the cart to return gRPC FailedPrecondition errors when accessing cart storage, which propagated to the frontend-proxy and produced high end-to-end latency and user-visible errors. The immediate failure is a lost/failed Redis connectivity (could be Redis down, network/DNS, or credentials misconfiguration); evidence collected points to the cart pod failing to connect rather than the cart pod crashing.
